INSERT INTO api_monitor_record (id, api_url, http_method, elapsed_ms, status_code, trace_id, app_name, server_ip, request_time, sharding_date) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.apiUrl}, #{item.httpMethod}, #{item.elapsedMs}, #{item.statusCode}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.appName}, #{item.serverIp}, #{item.requestTime}, #{item.shardingDate})

INSERT IGNORE INTO api_monitor_metrics (api_url, app_name, time_window, request_count, avg_ms, max_ms, min_ms, sharding_date) SELECT api_url, app_name, FROM_UNIXTIME(FLOOR(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(request_time) / 60) * 60) AS time_window, COUNT(*) AS request_count, ROUND(AVG(elapsed_ms), 2) AS avg_ms, MAX(elapsed_ms) AS max_ms, MIN(elapsed_ms) AS min_ms, DATE(request_time) AS sharding_date FROM api_monitor_record WHERE request_time >= #{startTime} AND request_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY api_url, app_name, time_window, sharding_date
